## Walkthrough

This PR introduces ed25519 signature verification test coverage for the project. A new TypeScript test module (`bin/test-runner/w3f/ed25519.ts`) is created with an `Ed25519Test` class and a `runEd25519Test` function that performs individual and batch ed25519 signature verification using WASM. The test runner is registered in `runners.ts` under the crypto/ed25519 path. Additionally, the test vectors reference in `.github/scripts/load-test-ref.sh` is updated to point to a new commit hash.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~15 minutes

- **`bin/test-runner/w3f/ed25519.ts`** (new file): Review the Ed25519Test class structure, JSON deserialization logic, WASM initialization flow, data transformation for verification, and assertion patterns
- **`bin/test-runner/w3f/runners.ts`**: Verify the test runner registration correctly wires the JSON test data with the execution function
- **`.github/scripts/load-test-ref.sh`**: Confirm the commit hash update is intentional and correct

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#808: Updates the same `load-test-ref.sh` REF value for test-vectors reference
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#795: Updates the same `load-test-ref.sh` script with a different commit-hash value
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#784: Modifies `load-test-ref.sh` by updating the REF/TEST_VECTORS_REF value
